programme.desc: Recognized documentarian, Emmy and BAFTA winner, Norma Percy, deals with the Israeli-Palestinian conflict and asks how it is possible that the conflict escalated during the intense search for peace in the Middle East.The filmmakers begin with Israel's withdrawal from the Gaza Strip in September 2005.The program reveals the behind-the-scenes of decades-long diplomatic disputes until October 7, 2023.Percy's interviewees, including:Hillary Clinton, Tony Blair and leading Israeli and Palestinian politicians discuss the causes of the dispute and breakthrough events in relations between the parties.

programme.title: Revolutions: Ideas That Changed the World
programme.desc: A fascinating journey through the history of our civilization told from the perspective of six technological inventions: a car, an airplane, a smartphone, a rocket, a robot and a telescope.

programme.title: The Secret History of World War II
programme.desc: World War II was the most tragic armed conflict in the history of mankind, which was not forgotten long after the last shot was fired.Decades after the end of the battles, their effects are felt, and many of the stories and facts related to them remain a mystery - they are passed over in silence by the victors or lost in the archives.The program reveals some of them.Dunkirk and D-Day, the German Blitz, the Battle of Britain and the incredible feats of Polish pilots from 303 Squadron, who played a key role in the final victory of the Allied forces, are just some of the key moments of the war, the unknown threads of which are only now becoming public.
